unusual_events.explanation: Fast electron beam: mean V_e = 369.7 km/s > 300 km/s threshold. Ratio v_beam/v_th = 0.074. When v_beam >> v_thermal, the electron velocity distribution function develops a positive slope df/dv > 0 at v_phase = ω_pe/k, which is the classical two-stream instability condition. Theory (Eq.18) predicts maximum growth rate γ_max at k_res = ω_pe/v_beam.

Unusually steep magnetic power spectrum: α = -2.551 (much steeper than Kolmogorov α = -5/3 = -1.667). This indicates enhanced dissipation at sub-ion scales, possibly due to Landau damping of kinetic Alfvén waves or reconnection-driven turbulence. Active Langmuir/TSI waves can inject energy into the perpendicular direction, feeding into the turbulent cascade.

electron_holes.note: 6 bipolar E∥ events above 4.42 mV/m — consistent with nonlinear TSI saturation products (electron holes/phase-space vortices)
